author: (J.V.Lamouroux) C.Agardh, 1822

note.en: A soft, fern-like red seaweed of rocky shores. Known from herbarium specimens from Puerto Limón (1962) and Piuta Point (1930).
note.es: Un alga roja blanda, parecida a un helecho, de costas rocosas. Se conoce por especímenes de herbario de Puerto Limón (1962) y Piuta Point (1930).

evidence: GBIF: 2 herbarium specimen records in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Herbarium specimens from Puerto Limón and Piuta Point.
